title: CNPOS Render Contract v1_2
description: Deterministic render-level contract for CNPOS v1_2 cinematic pipelines.

domain.description: Fixed domain identifier for render-level payloads.

version.description: Contract version; must match CNPOS v1_2.

render_id.description: Deterministic render job identifier (UUID or canonical string).

episode_id.description: Identifier of the episode this render belongs to.

scene_id.description: Optional scene identifier when rendering at scene granularity.

shot_id.description: Optional shot identifier when rendering at shot granularity.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the render job.

output.description: Output configuration for the render job.

codec.description: Video codec to use for rendering.

frame_rate.description: Frames per second for the render.

bitrate_kbps.description: Target video bitrate in kilobits per second.

audio_channels.description: Number of audio channels (e.g., 2 for stereo, 6 for 5.1).

assets.description: References to visual and audio assets used in the render.

video_tracks.description: Ordered list of video track descriptors.

source_path.description: Filesystem or storage path to the source video asset.

start_timecode.description: Start timecode within the source asset (e.g., 00:00:00:00).

end_timecode.description: End timecode within the source asset.

audio_tracks.description: Ordered list of audio track descriptors.

source_path.description: Filesystem or storage path to the source audio asset.

role.description: Role of the track (dialogue, music, effects, etc.).

timeline.description: Timeline events describing how assets are composed over time.

start_timecode.description: Start timecode of the event in the final render.

end_timecode.description: End timecode of the event in the final render.

params.description: Event-specific parameters (e.g., transition type, effect settings).

metadata.description: Auxiliary metadata for orchestration and telemetry.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the render payload.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp of the render payload.

pipeline_id.description: Identifier of the pipeline instance that produced/modified this payload.

orchestrator_id.description: Identifier of the orchestrator managing this render.

node_id.description: Identifier of the render node or worker executing the job.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the governance policy applied to this render.

flags.description: List of governance flags (e.g., content warnings, export constraints).
